gloss: deputy leader (of a group); vice-chief; second-in-command

definitions.gloss: the second-in-command of an organized group called a {団|だん}, such as a fan club, cheer squad, performing troupe, scout troop, or similar organization
definitions.explanation: Formed by attaching the prefix {副|ふく}- (vice-, deputy-) to {団長|だんちょう} (leader of a {団|だん}). A {団|だん} is a named, organized group — a troupe, troop, squad, regiment, fan club, cheering section, brass band, circus, martial arts group, or similar body. The {副団長|ふくだんちょう} supports the {団長|だんちょう} in running the group and takes charge in the leader's absence. The word is not usually used for business or political bodies, which take other "deputy" titles instead.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{消防団|しょうぼうだん}の{副団長|ふくだんちょう}だ。
examples.english: My father is the deputy leader of the volunteer fire brigade.

examples.japanese: {副団長|ふくだんちょう}として{団員|だんいん}をまとめる。
examples.english: To pull the members together as deputy leader.

examples.japanese: {応援団|おうえんだん}の{副団長|ふくだんちょう}が{先頭|せんとう}に{立|た}って{声援|せいえん}を{送|おく}った。
examples.english: The deputy leader of the cheering squad stood at the front and led the cheers.

examples.japanese: {団長|だんちょう}が{出張|しゅっちょう}のため、{副団長|ふくだんちょう}が{今日|きょう}の{練習|れんしゅう}を{仕切|しき}ることになった。
examples.english: Since the leader is away on a business trip, the deputy leader will run today's practice.

notes:
Composed of the prefix {副|ふく}- (vice-, deputy-) + {団長|だんちょう} (leader of a {団|だん}). Applies specifically to groups organized as a {団|だん}, which is a broader category than a club ({部|ぶ}) or committee ({委員会|いいんかい}).

COMMON GROUPS WITH A {副団長|ふくだんちょう}:
- {消防団|しょうぼうだん}: volunteer fire brigade
- {応援団|おうえんだん}: school/sports cheering squad
- {吹奏楽団|すいそうがくだん}: brass band, wind ensemble
- {劇団|げきだん}: theatrical troupe
- {楽団|がくだん}: musical ensemble, band
- {騎士団|きしだん}: order of knights (fantasy/history)
- ボーイスカウト: boy scout troop

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副団長|ふくだんちょう}を{務|つと}める: to serve as deputy leader
- {副団長|ふくだんちょう}に{就任|しゅうにん}する: to take up the post of deputy leader
- {副団長|ふくだんちょう}に{任命|にんめい}する: to appoint as deputy leader
- {団長|だんちょう}と{副団長|ふくだんちょう}: the leader and the deputy leader

RELATED ROLE TERMS:
- {団長|だんちょう}: leader of a {団|だん} — the head of any group organized as a {団|だん}.
- {副|ふく}{部長|ぶちょう}: vice-club-president — used for groups organized as a {部|ぶ} (club), not a {団|だん}.
- {副会長|ふくかいちょう}: vice-chairperson — used for groups organized around a {会|かい} (association, society).
- {副|ふく}キャプテン / {副|ふく}{主将|しゅしょう}: vice-captain — used for sports teams.

REGISTER:
Neutral and official-sounding. Appears on business cards, group rosters, and in news items about volunteer groups, fire brigades, student cheering squads, theater companies, and similar organizations.
